backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing videos, comments, likes, subscriptions, and user profiles with access control and seeded videos.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping app features to source files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file providing short human‑written summaries of numerous frontend files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions configuring light/dark color palettes and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the root div and bootstrapping the frontend app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App root wrapping the router in a ThemeProvider with a global Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting new users to enter and save their display name on first login.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth gate that blocks access for unauthenticated users and shows a sign‑in prompt.
frontend/src/components/comments/Comment: Form for posting comments that enforces authentication and subscription before submitting.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching videos, comments, likes, user subscription status, and performing related mutations via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS base styles and defines light and dark theme color variables with custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AccountPage.tsx: Renders the user account dashboard showing profile info and subscription status with options to manage them.
frontend/src/pages/BrowsePage.tsx: Displays a hero section and a grid of videos fetched from the catalog with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/VideoDetailPage.tsx: Shows video playback, details, likes, sharing, and comments, with profile checks and loading handling.
frontend/src/router.tsx: Configures the application routes for browsing, video detail, and protected account access using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/utils/share.ts: Provides helpers to generate shareable video URLs and share them via Web Share API or clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Implements utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, supporting both standard and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, typography, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines current project state, metadata, required images, and a list of implemented Pleiades TV app features.
